storyHeading: Keep your name on the invite and out of the blame list
storyParagraphs: You are the person everyone messages when a hotel room is missing, a transfer is late, or the agenda needs changing. Comfort Journey gives your team one real point of contact from the first WhatsApp message to the return trip. We build a plan around your dates, group size, hotel preference and work schedule, so the offsite feels organised before anyone boards a flight.

Since 1992, our Bhopal team has planned travel for people who want clear answers before they approve a budget. You can choose 3-star to 5-star hotels, palaces or villas, along with private cabs and drivers. For international plans, we can assist with visas. Prices are shared upfront, so finance sees the same plan as you do.

During the trip, real people remain available on WhatsApp and phone at +91 87704 03315, 24/7. That matters when a flight time shifts or someone asks a question at an unreasonable hour. Your team can enjoy the destination while you have a clear place to take the next practical question.

quickAnswer.question: Can Comfort Journey plan a corporate offsite with GST billing and custom arrangements?
quickAnswer.answer: Yes. Comfort Journey plans domestic and international corporate offsites with a custom itinerary, hotel options from 3-star to 5-star plus palaces or villas, private cabs with drivers, GST invoices and visa assistance for overseas trips. Dates, group size, hotel level, transport and activities change the price. A clear quote is shared upfront on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can you plan a corporate offsite around our dates and work schedule?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, group size, meeting time and preferred pace. Share the basic brief on WhatsApp and the team will suggest suitable routes.

faqs.q: What changes the price of a corporate tour package?
faqs.a: The quote changes with destination, travel dates, group size, hotel category, room setup, transport, meals, activities and flights. Comfort Journey shares an exact quote on WhatsApp after reviewing those details.

faqs.q: Do you provide GST invoices for company travel?
faqs.a: Yes. Comfort Journey provides GST invoices and transparent pricing shared upfront. Tell us any company billing details when you request the quote.

faqs.q: Can you arrange rooming lists and transport for a group?
faqs.a: Yes. The team can coordinate rooming lists, private cabs with drivers and agreed transfer plans. Conference halls, AV and airport coach arrangements can also be discussed where the itinerary needs them.

faqs.q: Do you handle international incentive trips and visas?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose international packages such as Dubai, Singapore, Thailand or Vietnam, then ask for changes to suit your group. Visa assistance is available for international trips, and the final quote is shared on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Will someone help us during the trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Real people are available on WhatsApp and phone at +91 87704 03315, 24/7 during trips. That gives the person coordinating the group a direct place to ask for help when plans change.

finalHeading: Ready to make the plan people thank you for?
finalText: Send your dates, group size and rough brief. We will reply with suitable routes and a clear WhatsApp quote.
